meaning.en: The newest PHP release in the list; on Windows its thread-safe build
meaning.zh: 列表中最新的 PHP 发行版；在 Windows 上为线程安全版

help.en: PHP 7.4 and later are built without PEAR, which provides the pear and pecl commands. Set this to yes to build with it; configure then prints a deprecation warning. On PHP 5.3 to 7.3, PEAR is built by default and PHP_WITHOUT_PEAR turns it off.
help.zh: PHP 7.4 及以后构建时默认不包含 PEAR，即 pear 与 pecl 命令。设为 yes 则包含，configure 随后会打印一条弃用警告。PHP 5.3 至 7.3 默认包含 PEAR，用 PHP_WITHOUT_PEAR 可以关闭。

help.en: PHP 8.4 and later are built without the mhash functions by default. Set this to yes to build with them; configure then prints a deprecation warning. The hash_* functions are there either way, and the variable has no effect before PHP 8.4.
help.zh: PHP 8.4 及以后构建时默认不包含 mhash 函数。设为 yes 则包含，configure 随后会打印一条弃用警告。hash_* 函数始终可用；此变量在 PHP 8.4 之前不起作用。

help.en: Whether a PHP built from source includes the PCRE JIT, which PHP has on by default. Unset or no keeps it on; yes builds without it.
help.zh: 从源码构建的 PHP 是否包含 PCRE JIT（PHP 默认开启）。未设置或为 no 时保持开启；为 yes 时不包含。

guide.en: Write the release as vfox search php lists it, such as 8.5.12. A line such as 8.4 installs its newest release. On Linux and macOS, -zts names the thread-safe build of a release. On Windows a plain version is the thread-safe build, and -nts names the non-thread-safe one.
guide.zh: 写 vfox search php 列出的发行版，如 8.5.12。8.4 这样的版本线会安装其中最新的版本。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，-zts 指某个发行版的线程安全构建。在 Windows 上，不带后缀的版本是线程安全构建，-nts 指非线程安全构建。

tips.en: On Linux and macOS PHP is compiled from source, which takes a while.
tips.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上 PHP 从源码编译，需要一段时间。

tips.en: Missing packages are named before compiling.
tips.zh: 编译前会列出缺少的软件包。

tips.en: Set PHP_CONFIGURE_OPTIONS and MAKEFLAGS in Settings, under Environment variables.
tips.zh: PHP_CONFIGURE_OPTIONS 与 MAKEFLAGS 接受任意文本：在“设置”的“环境变量”中以 KEY=VALUE 的形式设置。

tips.en: On Windows the install adds the Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime when it is missing, after Windows asks for permission.
tips.zh: 在 Windows 上，缺少 Visual C++ 2015-2022 运行库时，安装会在 Windows 请求授权后将其添加。
php@8.4 不会选中 -zts 或 -nts 构建。

tips.en: Detect and link needs vfox 1.1.0 or later.
tips.zh: 探测并链接需要 vfox 1.1.0 或更高版本。

title.en: Use a PHP that is already installed
